stories.title: Quarry near Mold set to go nearly 100 metres deeper under new plans
stories.summary: Heidelberg Materials UK wants to deepen Cefn Mawr Quarry near Mold and extend its working life by almost two decades, to February 2063. The company has submitted a scoping report to Flintshire County Council, the first step before a formal planning application to change the conditions attached to the quarry’s existing permission. stories.title: Pubs, cafés and gyms across Wales set for 30% rates cut
stories.summary: Pubs, cafés, hotels and gyms with a rateable value below £51,000 are set for a permanent 30 per cent cut to their business rates from April 2027, the Welsh Government has confirmed. The change would apply to food and drink hospitality venues, including pubs, restaurants, cafés, bars, food courts, licensed clubs and live music venues.

stories.title: Pubs and bars in Wales and England can now accept digital ID for alcohol sales
stories.summary: Pubs, bars, shops and other licensed premises in Wales and England can now choose to accept digital proof of age for alcohol sales, under new rules that came into force on Tuesday. The change means customers can use a certified app on their phone to confirm they are over 18, instead of showing physical ID.

stories.title: Petrol and diesel prices reach highest level since 2022
stories.summary: Petrol and diesel prices have reached their highest level since August 2022, with the RAC warning there is no end in sight to the rises.
